sloka: त्वत् अधीना वयम् सर्वे वने अस्मिन् शरणम् भवान् ।तस्मात् युध्यस्व भूयस्त्वम् मा शंकी च वानर ॥४-१२-३६॥
transliteration: tvat adhīnā vayam sarve vane asmin śaraṇam bhavān ।tasmāt yudhyasva bhūyastvam mā śaṁkī ca vānara ॥4-12-36॥

translations.english: 'Therefore, O monkey, go and engage yourself in fight again. Do not suspect me. With this single arrow of mine, in one moment you will see Vali thrown down and rolling on the ground in this combat.
